code: src <- tempfile("records"); dir.create(src) set.seed(1) big <- data.frame(gbifID = as.character(1:5000), kingdom = sample(c("Animalia", "Plantae"), 5000, TRUE),                   year = sample(1900:2020, 5000, TRUE), species = sample(letters, 5000, TRUE),                   decimalLongitude = runif(5000, -180, 180), decimalLatitude = runif(5000, -60, 70)) vectra::write_vtr(big[1:2500, ], file.path(src, "part-1.vtr")) vectra::write_vtr(big[2501:5000, ], file.path(src, "part-2.vtr"))  out <- flag_occurrences(src, out = tempfile("flags"), keep = c("kingdom", "year"), verbose = FALSE) out #> <occ_flagged> 5,000 records in 2 part(s) #>   out:       C:\Users\Gilles Colling\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpyE3iw8\flags1e11865912746 #>   tests:     val, zero, equ, cap, cen, inst, gbif, sea, dupl #>   layout:    v1 #>   reference: natural_earth (land 110; land_110 4.1.0, land_50 4.1.0, land_10 5.1.1, countries_50 5.1.1, urban_50 4.1.0, places_10 5.1.2, admin0_10 5.1.1, admin1_10 5.1.1, institutions 2026-10-09) #>   keep:      kingdom, year t <- tally_flags(out, by = "kingdom", bins = list(year = c(1950, 2000)),                  rules = list(cc = c("zero", "equ", "cap", "cen", "inst", "gbif", "sea"))) knitr::kable(t[, c("kingdom", "year_bin", "n", "flagged_sea", "flagged_cap", "removed_cc", "kept_cc")])

title: Fast Quality Flags for Species Occurrence Records at Any Scale
text: quality flags occurrence records, scale  OccurrenceCleaner extension CoordinateCleaner (Zizka et al. 2019) tailored large-scale occurrence data. flags common problems species occurrence records. include coordinates country centroids, capitals biodiversity institutions; zero equal coordinates; records sea wrong country; duplicates. also reads three GBIF fields: quality warnings GBIF attaches record processing (invalid rounded coordinates, fuzzy taxon match unlikely date), basis record (fossil living specimens), establishment means (introduced cultivated individuals). test stores result one bit per record. records removed: users decide afterwards flags use filtering. tests default buffers follow CoordinateCleaner, test suite checks packages return flags. difference speed scale: OccurrenceCleaner flags data frames containing million records seconds processes GBIF snapshots containing billions records reading Parquet files chunks. result x integer flags column one logical flag_<test> column per test. first record within 1 km GBIF headquarters 10 km Copenhagen, second zero coordinate sea, third Vienna, capital.

Proximity tests closed balls WGS84 geodesic distance. Records failing val given spatial flag. Documented differences CoordinateCleaner 3.0.1, verified package tests: CoordinateCleaner approximates buffer circle inscribed polygon (72 vertices cap, cen, gbif; 40 inst), record 99.9 % (cap, cen, gbif) 99.7 % (inst) buffer buffer flagged may . Everything CoordinateCleaner flags flagged . cc_zero's 0.5 degree buffer interpreted terra 0.5 metres, CoordinateCleaner 3.0.1 flags exact zeros; package applies documented 0.5 degree radius. coun compares record's code alpha-2 alpha-3 codes Natural Earth country polygon point falls ; CoordinateCleaner compares alpha-3 .
